slides.text: Ranking number one no longer means you're seen
slides.voiceover_text: Here's an uncomfortable truth for anyone who's paid for SEO. Ranking number one on Google no longer guarantees you actually get seen.

slides.text: Google's AI answer cites its own sources up top
slides.voiceover_text: Tip one. Google now puts an AI answer at the top of the results, with its own handful of cited sources underneath.

slides.text: It often skips number one and quotes position five
slides.voiceover_text: Tip two. The data shows it often skips the top result entirely, and quotes a page from position five or eight instead.

slides.text: Win citations with clear answers to real questions
slides.voiceover_text: Tip three. What earns the citation isn't position, it's content that answers the real question directly and clearly, so it's easy to lift.

slides.text: Ranking still matters, but it's not the whole picture
slides.voiceover_text: So remember. Your local SEO still matters, it's just no longer the whole picture. Write the clear answer, and you get cited.
